_about: Enrichment fields requested from the model AND the field dictionary of the deterministic candidate harvester. The research prompt, field-state evaluation, targeted field recovery, the finalizer bundle, coverage metrics, Hebrew UI labels and deterministic candidate extraction are all driven by this file: add a field here (or pass ENRICHMENT_FIELDS / ENRICHMENT_SCHEMA_PATH) and it gets the same treatment with no code change. Keys: name (required), description, group, unit, applies_to (Level 1.5 propulsion_normalized values; omitted = all vehicles), recovery_attempts (overrides FIELD_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS; 0 = never retried), display_name_he (Hebrew label for the UI). Dictionary keys (all optional; a field without aliases is simply not harvested): matcher (numeric | boolean | enum | gearbox | tire_size | charging_time | charging_window | warranty | price | text), component (part of a compound matcher this field takes), aliases_he / aliases_en / abbreviations (labels that identify the field), positive_context_terms_he/_en (raise parser confidence; with require_context at least one must be near the value), negative_context_terms_he/_en (reject a match unless positive context is also present), expected_units / accepted_unit_variants / normalized_unit, value_type, patterns (regex -> value for fixed textual forms), plausible_min / plausible_max (parser sanity range only, never truth), enum_values, conversion_rules (exact unit arithmetic only), ambiguity_rules (attach a hint and lower parser confidence), exclusion_rules (reject when a term is present unless an `unless` term is too), warranty_kind. A harvested candidate is NEVER evidence: it only lists values the code located for the model to review. Semantic / admission keys: semantic_definition (what the field means, shown to models), binding_requirement (exact_technical_variant | exact_market_trim | body_powertrain: the server-side document binding a value needs to count as variant_match=exact), time_sensitive (the value is valid as of a date), semantic_exclusions ([{terms, applies_to?, reason}]: evidence whose value clause uses these terms states a different quantity and is rejected by the admission gate), not_applicable_when ([{field, values}]: the field is not applicable when admitted target evidence of another field has one of these values). applies_to for charging / range fields is plug_in + battery_electric: a regular hybrid does not plug in. Recovery / market keys: recovery_cluster (technical_spec | performance | charging_ev | equipment | multimedia | tires_wheels | commercial | warranty: fields one kind of source usually answers together; the tail recovery unit), market_sensitivity (high | medium | low: how much the value can differ between markets for the same technical variant), portability_scope (none | exact_technical_variant: the binding level at which an official foreign-market fact may count for the target market when no target-market source contradicts it; the source market is never rewritten), unknown_market_policy (not_target | portable; default not_target: an item whose market the source does not establish is never target-market evidence by itself; portable lets it count for the target market only through the same deterministic portability verdict as an official foreign fact, and only on a field whose portability_scope is not none and market_sensitivity is not high; its market stays unknown). Reuse key: reuse_scope (none | exact_market_trim | exact_technical_variant | body_powertrain): the identity scope within which an admitted, exactly bound fact may be reused for another variant (src/research_memory.py); a reused fact is re-admitted against the new target and must bind exactly again, so a source naming another powertrain never crosses (body_powertrain is supported for fields whose own binding requirement is body_powertrain). Commercial, warranty, equipment, multimedia and tyre fields are never reused; time-sensitive fields never are.

harvest_vocabulary._about: Shared vocabularies of the generic matchers in src/candidate_harvest.py. Field-specific wording lives on each field; these lists are reused across fields of the same kind. number_words: written numbers the evidence admission gate reads as numbers (entailment only; the harvester does not use them). negation_prefixes: a negation written right before a feature label (ללא חלון גג, without sunroof) states the feature is absent. availability_statement_terms: words that explicitly state a feature is present; the admission gate accepts a model-promoted boolean only when its quote states availability (these terms or an affirmative / negative value) and the field's own parse does not contradict it.

fields.name: torque_nm
fields.semantic_definition: Peak torque in Nm, by propulsion class (never chosen per vehicle by the model): conventional = combustion engine peak torque; hybrid and plug_in = the COMBUSTION ENGINE's peak torque only (electric-motor and combined/system torque are different quantities and are not this field); battery_electric = total electric-motor peak torque as published.

semantic_exclusions.reason: for hybrids torque_nm is the combustion engine's torque; motor / system torque is a different quantity

fields.name: acceleration_0_100_s
fields.semantic_definition: 0-100 km/h time in seconds as published (0-60 mph is a different quantity).

fields.name: top_speed_kmh
fields.semantic_definition: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h (the electric-only top speed of a plug-in hybrid is not this field).

fields.name: fuel_consumption_combined_l_100km
fields.description: Combined FUEL consumption in l/100km (combustion/hybrid only; never put kWh/100km here)

conversion_rules.note: exact arithmetic (100 / km-per-litre), rounded to 2 decimals

exclusion_rules.reason: a partial test cycle, not the combined figure

fields.semantic_definition: Official combined-cycle fuel consumption in l/100km (WLTP where the source states it; plug-in hybrids: the weighted combined figure, not the charge-sustaining one).

semantic_exclusions.reason: charge-sustaining consumption of a plug-in hybrid

fields.name: energy_consumption_kwh_100km
fields.description: EV energy consumption (kWh/100km, with test standard)
fields.semantic_definition: Combined electric energy consumption in kWh/100km of a plug-in vehicle (BEV, or a PHEV's electric consumption).

fields.name: battery_gross_kwh

exclusion_rules.reason: usable (net) capacity belongs to the usable-capacity field

fields.semantic_definition: Gross (total) traction-battery energy capacity in kWh.

fields.name: battery_usable_kwh
fields.semantic_definition: Usable (net) traction-battery energy capacity in kWh.

fields.name: electric_range_km

exclusion_rules.reason: a charging-speed statement (range added), not the range

fields.semantic_definition: All-electric driving range in km of a plug-in vehicle, combined cycle as published (city-only range is not this field); the cycle goes in electric_range_standard.

fields.name: electric_range_standard

ambiguity_rules.note: the standard may refer to consumption

fields.semantic_definition: Test cycle of electric_range_km (WLTP, EPA, CLTC, NEDC).

fields.name: ac_charging_time
fields.semantic_definition: AC (on-board charger) charging time of a plug-in vehicle as published, with its stated window/power when given.

fields.name: dc_charging_time
fields.semantic_definition: DC fast-charging time of a plug-in vehicle as published, with its stated window.

fields.name: dc_charging_window_pct
fields.semantic_definition: State-of-charge window (percent) of the published DC charging time.

fields.name: ac_max_charging_power_kw
fields.semantic_definition: Maximum AC charging power in kW of a plug-in vehicle.

fields.name: dc_max_charging_power_kw

exclusion_rules.reason: motor / system output, not charging power

fields.semantic_definition: Maximum DC charging power in kW of a plug-in vehicle.

fields.name: length_mm

exclusion_rules.reason: a measurement of a part (cargo floor, seat, cable), not the vehicle body

fields.semantic_definition: Overall body length in mm.

fields.name: width_mm

exclusion_rules.reason: a measurement of a part (cargo floor, seat, cable), not the vehicle body

ambiguity_rules.note: width with/without mirrors is stated in the source

fields.semantic_definition: Overall body width in mm EXCLUDING mirrors (width with mirrors is a different quantity).

fields.name: height_mm

exclusion_rules.reason: a measurement of a part (cargo floor, seat, cable), not the vehicle body

fields.semantic_definition: Overall height of the unladen vehicle in mm; when the source states a condition (with roof rails, with antenna) it is kept as the value's condition.

fields.name: wheelbase_mm
fields.semantic_definition: Wheelbase in mm.

fields.name: curb_weight_kg

exclusion_rules.reason: gross / towing / payload weight, not the curb weight

fields.semantic_definition: Curb (kerb) weight in kg as published (an EU 'mass in running order' includes a 75 kg driver; the source wording stays in the quote).

fields.name: ground_clearance_mm
fields.semantic_definition: Minimum ground clearance of the unladen vehicle in mm.

fields.name: cargo_volume_l
fields.semantic_definition: Luggage-compartment volume in litres with all seats in use (seats-folded / maximum volume and a front trunk are not this field). Depends on body AND powertrain (battery packaging).

fields.name: fuel_tank_l
fields.semantic_definition: Fuel tank capacity in litres.

fields.name: gearbox_type
fields.semantic_definition: Transmission type (automatic, manual, dct, cvt, e-cvt, single-speed, amt).

fields.name: gear_count
fields.semantic_definition: Number of discrete forward gear ratios, only when the source states it. Not applicable when the gearbox has no discrete stepped gear count (CVT, e-CVT). Never inferred from the gearbox type.

fields.name: screen_size_in

exclusion_rules.reason: a wheel/tire size, not a screen size

fields.semantic_definition: Diagonal of the central infotainment screen in inches (instrument cluster and head-up display are not this field).

fields.name: apple_carplay
fields.semantic_definition: Apple CarPlay support on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: android_auto
fields.semantic_definition: Android Auto support on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: wireless_phone_projection

exclusion_rules.reason: wireless phone charging, not phone projection

fields.semantic_definition: Wireless CarPlay / Android Auto on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: power_seats
fields.semantic_definition: Electrically adjustable front seat(s) on this trim, at least the driver's (true / false).

fields.name: heated_seats
fields.semantic_definition: Heated front seats on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: ventilated_seats
fields.semantic_definition: Ventilated (cooled) front seats on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: climate_zones

patterns.note: schema mapping: Hebrew 'split' (מפוצלת) climate control = dual-zone

fields.semantic_definition: Number of independently controlled climate zones on this trim. A word form maps to a number only through an explicit pattern in this schema.

fields.name: sunroof_panoramic
fields.semantic_definition: Sunroof or panoramic glass roof on this trim (true / false).

fields.name: other_comfort_features
fields.semantic_definition: Other comfort equipment of this trim, as listed by the source.

fields.name: rim_diameter_in

exclusion_rules.reason: a screen size, not a wheel size

patterns.note: rim diameter as stated inside a tire size

fields.semantic_definition: Standard wheel rim diameter of this trim in inches.

fields.name: tire_size_front
fields.semantic_definition: Standard front tire size of this trim.

fields.name: tire_size_rear
fields.semantic_definition: Standard rear tire size of this trim.

fields.name: alternative_tire_sizes
fields.semantic_definition: Optional / alternative tire sizes offered for this trim.

fields.name: local_trim_name
fields.description: Local commercial trim name of this exact variant
fields.semantic_definition: Commercial trim name used in the target market.

fields.name: list_price

exclusion_rules.reason: a payment, fee or discount, not the list price

ambiguity_rules.note: a starting price may belong to another trim

fields.semantic_definition: Importer list price of this exact local trim in the target market (time-sensitive: valid as of a date).

fields.name: registration_licence_fee
fields.semantic_definition: Annual registration/licence fee in the target market (time-sensitive: valid as of a date).

fields.name: vehicle_warranty
fields.semantic_definition: Vehicle (basic) warranty terms in the target market (time-sensitive).

fields.name: battery_hybrid_warranty
fields.semantic_definition: Traction-battery / hybrid-system warranty terms in the target market (time-sensitive).

fields.name: warranty_km
fields.semantic_definition: Vehicle warranty distance limit in km in the target market (time-sensitive).

fields.name: warranty_years
fields.semantic_definition: Vehicle warranty duration in years in the target market (time-sensitive).
